text:
Situation: Leucovorin calcium has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2012-01-01 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 178 months. Corvale East holds critically low stock across three presentations: 10 mg tablets at 13.7 days, 350 mg/7.5 mL vials at 2.9 days, and 50 mg/5 mL vials at 2.7 days. Corvale General holds three lots totaling 192.87 units with 18.7 to 27.7 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 19 units of the 50 mg/5 mL vial with 24.5 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA posted the shortage on 2012-01-01. A Warning Letter was issued to Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (FEI 1510690) on 2009-03-30, 1007 days before the posting. An inspection of that plant ended 2011-01-20 with a VAI classification, 346 days before the posting. Subsequent inspections of that plant in 2014, 2018, and 2026 were classified VAI or NAI. Cerbios-Pharma SA (FEI 3002808250), another registered plant, received a VAI classification on 2024-03-07.

Our position: Internal transfers can immediately improve days on hand at Corvale East using existing inventory at Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside. External purchases from suppliers not on the FDA shortage list are available but their manufacturing sites are unidentified.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute Option 1: Transfer 8 units of leucovorin calcium 50 mg/5 mL 5 mL vial from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Execute Option 2: Transfer 70 units from Corvale General to Corvale East across needed presentations. Approval: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
3. Initiate purchase orders with American Health Packaging, Epic Pharma LLC, and Ingenus Pharmaceuticals, LLC for needed presentations. Approval: Buyer.

Not recommended: Delaying transfers pending external orders; Corvale East stock is below safety thresholds for two injectable presentations.
